title: DataDome is the First Bot & Agent Trust Management Partner to Support Network Calls on Amazon CloudFront Functions (CF2)
content:
Black Friday traffic won’t wait for your infrastructure, and neither should your bot protection. DataDome is now generally available with network calls on Amazon CloudFront Functions (CF2), making it faster, easier, and cheaper to protect your apps and content on AWS.

DataDome is the first bot and agent trust management vendor to integrate and deploy with network calls on Amazon CloudFront Functions (CF2).

What’s new with CloudFront Functions

AWS CloudFront Functions is a serverless edge-computing feature that lets you run lightweight JavaScript code directly at Amazon CloudFront edge locations.

CloudFront Functions now supports making network calls from within a function’s event handler. This capability lets you fetch resources across the network asynchronously during request processing. 

Our new CloudFront Functions integration doesn’t have to replace the existing Lambda@Edge integration, which keeps working as is for customers. But CF2 offers an upgraded experience that makes DataDome faster, easier, and cheaper to run. 

Simpler setup and migration 

Deploys in production in minutes, with no infrastructure to provision or manage worldwide. Existing customers already using Lambda@Edge keep running, and our migration guide provides a clear path when you decide to move.

Improved detection accuracy, including TLS fingerprinting

Enables new edge signals like TLS fingerprints (JA3 and JA4) for all request traffic that helps detect and block malicious bots and AI agents more effectively.

Greater scalability and performance 

Scales up to 10 million requests per second, so launch days and flash sales never impede your protection.

Faster incident response

Automatic log enrichment adds context to CloudFront logs. You get cleaner SIEM integration and correlation, with no log pipeline to build first.

Significant AWS cost savings

Early estimates show up to 60% lower AWS CloudFront serverless computing costs for DataDome customers.

Better together: DataDome & AWS 

Managing AI bots and agents is a strategic priority for CISOs and business leaders. Together, AWS and DataDome make that easier. 

AWS provides the scale, global reach, and application services that businesses depend on. DataDome adds the agentic layer for better visibility, intent-based detection, and real-time protection that ensures your traffic is trustworthy. 

Amazon CloudFront and AWS WAF serve as the foundation for application delivery and baseline security, and DataDome provides a defense-in-depth layer to block sophisticated bots and govern agentic traffic. Many DataDome customers take this approach: over 60% use both a CDN security layer and DataDome together. 

Meanwhile, shoppers are lining up for Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals as they plan their holiday purchases online. For AWS customers, protecting that traffic against malicious scraper and scalper bots or untrusted AI agents just got easier, faster, and cheaper.

Get started with CF2

DataDome customers have already started migrating to CF2 to reap the benefits. Learn how DataDome can help you protect your AWS-hosted applications, reduce fraud, and control AI agent traffic without slowing down legitimate users. Start with a free assessment of your bot and agent exposure and get DataDome on the AWS Marketplace. 

DataDome is exhibiting at AWS re:Invent 2026 from November 30 to December 4 at the Venetian Convention Center in Las Vegas. We’d love to talk—set up a meeting or drop by our booth #927.

There’s more: DataDome is also a launch partner for Buyer Contact Share

Buyer Contact Share on AWS Marketplace gives sellers a buyer’s contact information at the moment of subscription so onboarding can begin in minutes. DataDome is a launch partner for this new feature, which underscores our close partnership with AWS.

With Buyer Contact Share, DataDome receives a customer’s name, email, company, and country or region when they subscribe on AWS Marketplace, via a single AWS Marketplace API, so DataDome can provision access, send a welcome email, and begin onboarding right away. This helps our customers on AWS Marketplace to start using DataDome faster and ensure the traffic reaching their business is traffic they can trust.
